schemes.name: PM MUDRA Yojana
schemes.agency: Dept. of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance · via any scheduled bank / Jan Samarth Portal
schemes.amount: Shishu up to ₹50,000 · Kishor up to ₹5 lakh · Tarun up to ₹10 lakh · Tarun Plus up to ₹20 lakh
schemes.interest: Bank-determined, no ceiling fixed by scheme; processing fee nil on Shishu, ~0.5% on Kishor/Tarun
eligibility: Indian citizen aged 18-65
Non-farm income-generating micro/small enterprise (manufacturing, trading or services)
Tarun Plus requires a prior fully-repaid Tarun loan
howToApply: Apply via any scheduled bank, NBFC or MFI, or online via the Jan Samarth Portal
Submit business plan and KYC documents
Loan sanctioned against MUDRA Card for working capital drawdown

schemes.name: PMEGP (Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme)
schemes.agency: KVIC · Ministry of MSME (delivered via KVIC, State KVIBs and District Industries Centres)
schemes.amount: Project cost up to ₹50 lakh (manufacturing) or ₹20 lakh (service/trading); subsidy 15-25% general, 25-35% for SC/ST/OBC/women/PwD/NE/ex-servicemen and special categories
schemes.interest: Bank loan rate on the balance after subsidy
eligibility: Age 18 and above
New unit only — one person per family, no prior PMEGP/state subsidy on this project
Own contribution 10% (general) or 5% (special category incl. SC/ST/OBC/women/PwD/NE)
documents: Caste/category certificate if claiming special-category margin
howToApply: Apply online at kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal
Interview at KVIC/KVIB/DIC
Bank appraisal and sanction
Mandatory EDP training before subsidy release
schemes.sourceTitle: PMEGP e-Portal — KVIC, Ministry of MSME

schemes.name: CGTMSE — Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises
schemes.amount: Collateral-free credit guarantee cover up to ₹10 crore per borrower (as of Apr 2025)
schemes.interest: Guarantee cover 75% of loan, up to 85% for micro enterprises, women, SC/ST and North-East borrowers; +5% extra in RBI-identified credit-deficient districts
eligibility: Micro or small enterprise as per MSME classification
Loan extended by a CGTMSE member lending institution (most banks/NBFCs)
Not a substitute for the loan itself — this only guarantees it, doesn't disburse cash
documents: Loan sanction letter from lending bank
howToApply: Apply for the underlying business loan at a member bank/NBFC
Bank applies for CGTMSE cover on your behalf — no separate applicant paperwork

schemes.name: Stand-Up India
schemes.agency: SIDBI · scheduled commercial banks (Dept. of Financial Services)
schemes.amount: ₹10 lakh – ₹1 crore, composite loan (term loan + working capital)
schemes.interest: Bank base rate + tenor premium + up to 3%, capped per scheme guidelines
eligibility: SC/ST and/or woman entrepreneur, age 18+
Greenfield project — first-time venture in manufacturing, services, trading or agri-allied activity
For group enterprises, at least 51% stake held by an SC/ST or woman promoter
howToApply: Apply via Stand-Up India portal (standupmitra.in) or directly at a scheduled commercial bank branch
Handholding support available through the portal
Bank appraisal and sanction

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma
schemes.agency: Ministry of MSME / Ministry of Skill Development
schemes.amount: Collateral-free loans up to ₹3 lakh in two tranches (₹1 lakh, then ₹2 lakh) + ₹15,000 toolkit e-voucher + skill training stipend
eligibility: Engaged in one of 18 traditional trades (carpenter, blacksmith, potter, tailor, cobbler, mason and others), working with hands and tools
Registered/engaged in the trade on date of registration
Must not have taken a similar self-employment loan (PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, MUDRA) for business development in the last 5 years
First tranche requires completing Basic Skill Training
howToApply: Register free via a Common Service Centre (CSC) or pmvishwakarma.gov.in
Verification by local body/ULB
Complete Basic Training, then access toolkit e-voucher and first loan tranche

schemes.name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
schemes.amount: Up to ₹20 lakh grant (proof of concept/prototype) + up to ₹50 lakh via convertible debentures/debt (market entry, scaling)
schemes.interest: N/A for grant portion; debt portion terms set by the incubator disbursing funds
schemes.deadline: Rolling, subject to scheme's overall ₹945 crore outlay and incubator selection cycles
eligibility: DPIIT-recognised startup, incorporated not more than 2 years ago
At least 51% owned by Indian founders
Must not have received more than ₹10 lakh in earlier government grants/aid
Sole proprietorships and public limited companies not eligible
howToApply: Apply via seedfund.startupindia.gov.in to an approved incubator
Incubator evaluation committee reviews and disburses
schemes.sourceTitle: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme — official portal

schemes.name: NBCFDC Individual/General Loan Scheme
schemes.agency: National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation · Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
schemes.amount: Individual Loan Scheme up to ₹25 lakh; General Loan up to ₹15 lakh; Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (women, OBC) up to ₹1 lakh
schemes.interest: Concessional, NBCFDC funds ~85% via channel partner, beneficiary/channel partner covers the rest
eligibility: Belongs to a notified Other Backward Class
Annual family income up to ₹5 lakh (Individual Loan Scheme) or ₹3 lakh (General Loan)
Applied through an approved State Channelising Agency or bank
howToApply: Apply through your State OBC Finance Corporation (channelising agency) or partner bank
Project appraisal and sanction

schemes.name: Divyangjan Swavalamban Yojana (NHFDC)
schemes.agency: National Divyangjan Finance & Development Corporation (NDFDC/NHFDC) · Dept. of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
schemes.amount: Loans up to ₹50 lakh for income-generating activity; Vishesh Microfinance Yojana up to ₹60,000 for micro-enterprise
schemes.interest: Concessional, roughly 5-9% p.a.; extra 1% rebate for women with disabilities on loans up to ₹50,000
eligibility: Indian citizen with 40% or more disability (relaxed to age 14 for persons with intellectual disability)
Age 18 and above (standard route)
Viable income-generating business plan
howToApply: Apply through State Channelising Agency for persons with disabilities, or NHFDC directly
Project appraisal and disbursal

schemes.name: NSKFDC Micro Credit Finance Scheme
schemes.agency: National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation · Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
schemes.amount: Small/Petty Business Scheme up to ₹60,000; Micro Credit Finance Scheme up to ₹1 lakh (with up to 50% subsidy, capped ₹10,000, for BPL beneficiaries)
schemes.interest: Concessional, via channelising agency; beneficiary margin money ~10%
eligibility: Safai Karamchari, manual scavenger, or their dependent
Viable small business or income-generating activity
howToApply: Apply through State Safai Karamchari Finance & Development Corporation or authorised channel partner

schemes.name: NSFDC Term Loan Scheme
schemes.agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation · Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
schemes.amount: Up to ₹30 lakh (up to 90% of project cost); education/skill loans up to ₹4 lakh for courses up to 2 years
schemes.interest: ~4% p.a. to beneficiary (0.5% further rebate for women), repayment up to 7 years
eligibility: Belongs to a Scheduled Caste
Annual family income up to ₹5 lakh
Viable income-generating project
howToApply: Apply through State SC Finance & Development Corporation (channelising agency)
Project appraisal and sanction

schemes.name: NSTFDC Term Loan Scheme
schemes.agency: National Scheduled Tribes Finance & Development Corporation · Ministry of Tribal Affairs
schemes.amount: Term Loan up to ₹50 lakh (up to 90% of project cost); Adivasi Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana up to ₹2 lakh for ST women; Margin Money Support under Stand-Up India up to 15% of project cost
schemes.interest: Concessional, via State ST Finance & Development Corporation
eligibility: Belongs to a Scheduled Tribe
Viable income-generating project
ST women may use the dedicated Adivasi Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana route
howToApply: Apply through State ST Finance & Development Corporation (channelising agency)

schemes.name: SMILE — Support for Marginalised Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise (transgender component)
schemes.amount: Skill training with stipend, Garima Greh shelter with food/medical care, education support Class IX through postgraduate; not a direct business loan — feeds into MUDRA/PMEGP/Stand-Up India for enterprise credit
schemes.interest: N/A — grant/welfare scheme, not a loan product
eligibility: Self-identifies as transgender
Seeking skilling, shelter, education support or livelihood linkage
documents: Transgender identity certificate (issued under the Transgender Persons Act) or self-declaration as applicable
howToApply: Apply via the National Portal for Transgender Persons (transgender.dosje.gov.in) or nearest Garima Greh
Training partner assigns market-linked skilling
schemes.sourceTitle: National Portal for Transgender Persons — Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
